name: Nahuel Huapi Traverse
region: Nahuel Huapi National Park, Catedral to Cerro López
why: Bariloche's classic hut-to-hut: four granite valleys, three passes and a lake by every hut, from Cerro Catedral to Cerro López.
book: Book the huts (Frey, San Martín/Jakob, Italia at Laguna Negra, López) and register the trek online. Bus 55 to Villa Catedral; from the end at Ruta 79 by Arroyo López, bus 10 back to Bariloche.
water: Streams and lakes at every hut; the passes are dry. Meals at the huts.
dangers: Jakob to Laguna Negra is graded extreme: steep loose scree and hand-on-rock steps. Walk it only in that direction.
Snow lies on the passes into January: the Jakob-Negra stage is advised from February.
Wind and cloud on the ridges; no way off between huts.
turnaround: On each pass stage, leave the hut by 08:00 and turn back if the pass is not reached by 13:00.

points.name: Villa Catedral
points.note: Cerro Catedral ski base. 10 km and 700 m through forest along the Van Titter stream to the first hut.

points.name: Refugio Frey
points.note: 1,740 m: stone hut on Laguna Toncek under the Catedral needles. Next day: over the ridge and down the Rucaco valley to Jakob, 8-10 h.

points.name: Refugio San Martín, Laguna Jakob
points.note: 1,564 m on Laguna Jakob. The hardest stage follows: 10 km and 850 m over the Cordón de los Inocentes to Laguna Negra.

points.name: Laguna Negra, Refugio Italia
points.note: Refugio Manfredo Segre at 1,609 m on a dark lake under Cerro Negro. On to López: 8 km and 500 m along the ridge, 5-6 h.

points.name: Refugio López
points.note: Under Pico Turista, looking down on Lago Nahuel Huapi. Food and beds; from here a 4 km track zigzags down to the road.

points.name: Ruta 79 at Arroyo López
points.note: End of the traverse on the Circuito Chico road near Colonia Suiza, by the bus stop for Bariloche.
